title: How do I keep in touch with old friends after moving?
L: (1) Dana: Help! My best friend moved to another city last month, and I'm scared we'll lose touch.
We used to see each other every day, but now we hardly even text.
How do you keep in touch with old friends after you move away?
(2) Leo: I moved two years ago, so I know how you feel.
Set a regular time to video call, like every Sunday evening.
It doesn't have to be long. Even twenty minutes helps.
(3) Priya: Don't wait for them to message you first.
Send a quick photo or a funny meme when you think of them.
Small things keep a friendship alive, and you could even plan a visit during the holidays.

exq.a: She is afraid of losing touch with her friend.
w: She cannot find a new city.
She does not like video calls.

exq.q: When does Leo suggest having a video call?
How long can the call be, according to Leo?
What does Priya advise Dana to do?
w: Wait for her friend to call
